comment: So lucky to have had Dr. Treadway as my professor at UofR. He of course knew his bailiwick, but had the additional benefit of being a first class human, available and caring. But hatch out for those multiple choice questions where you might find the names of your fellow students in the mix to mislead you.

My favorite professor at the University of Richmond. Cares about the topics, and actually enjoys teaching. He will sit and chat with you about a variety of topics if you visit his office, wish i took his class more!
Probably the best professor at the university. Extremely knowledgeable and engaging. Very funny in class and overall an absolute must. Take as many classes with him as you can!

Excellent professor. Map quiz so you understand territory your covering and gives  deeper understanding of the material incorporated. If Modern Germany, understand Germany. world war 1 or 2, look at the chaos Europe was in and understand the colonization schemes. Take him as much as possible.
Brilliant. His class is super fun!
Professor Treadway is an amazing lecturer, professor and person. His classes are really fun. Take him while you still can!!

He is a great guy for majors and non-majors alike! His lectures are always amusing, and also contain a lot of interesting information. They can be a bit disorganized, but that is just his style. He seems to be universally liked, and just generally a cool guy. Do your work and you will do well, no major grade pitfalls.  Rated hot out of respect :P

Treadway is such a great guy! He's so funny in class and even though I am not at all interested in history, I feel like I learned a lot. Even though he says there will be many papers, you will only do a few. And as long as you pay attention in class and put the work in outside of class, you will get s good grade.
Treadway is an amazing professor! He's helpful, interesting and very funny.  I would love to take another class with him!
Keeps the class engaged and awake.  But he's so scatter-brained our class doesn't know what to expect on the test. Hard grader for papers.
Treadway is my favorite professor at Richmond. Take him as many times as you can. Very clear and fair. Several quizzes to make sure you understand, but no tricks.

The best professor at UofR. The best Professor. Period. Dr. Treadway, I really hope you are reading this. Please don't change who you are. You make us learn and make it fun, while also making us laugh. You are more than helpful, brilliant and always willing to help those with your "can-do, will-do" attitude. If you can even get in, TAKE HIS CLASS!!

Treadway is easily the best teacher I have ever had.  You will learn SO much, and love learning.  He has incredible stories about his life in Eastern and Southern Europe and you are hanging on every word he says.  TAKE ANY AND EVERY CLASS YOU CAN WITH HIM

Dr. Treadway was and is the best lecturer, teacher, and mentor anyone could wish for.  He invests in each student.  No matter what your grade, you walk out of that class knowing more, enjoying history, and liking him as a person (Professor Stokes was right!).  YOu might think he's off topic, but there's always a method and intent.

He's the deal. Incredibly smart guy. Cool as well as fun. You can get him side tracked on tangents because he's so engaged in the history he teaches. It was not hard for me to get an A in his history 100 class. Just do that work and raise your hand every once in a while.

Treadway is a really enjoyable professor.  Like some people said, he does stray off-topic easily, but he is also really knowledgeable.  His tangents are still informative about somewhat-related history. He has a really great sense of humor as well.  He is a pretty easy grader.

Treadway is star history prof.,  Ridiculously knowledgeable, suspect he wings lectures. Charming/good natured guy and the class is flexible & easy. However,he is not for everyone-if student needs structured class, don't take. never gave us syllabus, his expectations weren't clear which added unnecessary difficulty but he'll work it out with you.
He is the best history teacher I've ever had!!!!!

Just though I should add my 2 cents... Hist 100 was supposed to cover the entire cold war. we just got to the beginning of vietnam. i wanted to learn things in the class, but we rarely got to lectures because he'd talk about other things untill 10 min were left in the class. nicest man ever... but as a prof, i didn't learn anything!
No Comments

Treadway is a fascinating guy. He's smart and knows history. He cares about his students. That said, he would greatly benefit them by getting himself together as a professor. He is a remarkably slow grader, and that's detrimental. How he can expect us to do his assignments on time when he doesn't afford that to us is puzzling, to say the least.

Dr. Treadway is the best, smartest, funniest and most interesting proffesor I've ever had. He makes you love history even if you hated it before.His class is gone in seconds, that explaines everything.In the beginning he will assign 3 papers but you'll probably have only one in the end. Learn to love map quizzes because you'll have them constantly.
a great professor. makes me feel happy to pay 30,000 dollars per year. that explains everything.

Hands down the smartest, funniest, and just...best teacher I ever had at UR.  Terribly easy to distract him from the topic at hand, but you will learn so much from his rants in addition to the syllabus.  Speaking of which, you might want to throw that away on Day 1, because it will definitely change at least 3-4 times over the course of the semester (although, dropping a paper never hurt anyone).  The key is to mention anything about the Balkans, open your ears, and just take in everything he says.
No Comments
This guy is a genius!

Best prof i've had at UR.  Extremely interesting and knowledgable.  Nice and helpful outside of class.  Very fair grader.  I took an extra course beyond my minor just to take another one of his classes
Extremely talented professor ... incredibly disorganized but that's what makes him so loveable :)

Really smart and most loved prof on campus. So great! Very knowledgeable and really amazingly adaptable and understanding to the Balkan culture. Really good Bulgarian accent and lover of our culture. You want to learn about us, the Balkan ppl, take his class. Wish one day to be like him, super prof!
So fun to listen to this guy . . . I just wish I had taken it during the semester, not May Term, so I would have had more time to soak up all that info.
Greatest professor I have ever had. Absolutely incredible. Take very class he offers and you'll enjoy every moment!

One of the most intelligent people I have ever met. He has the rare gift of being a medium of learning; being able to take that massive amount of information and making it concise and interesting. This is the kind of teacher that I hoped to get when I came here. Also a great person in general.
All the other reviews are right-- he is the best professor here.  He goes off on tangents but you always learn a lot.  Take him as often as you can.
Best teacher in the department, my favorite in 4 years there.  Minored just to take his classes.

Notoriously slow grader but best professor on campus bar-none. You will have fun and you will learn a TON. Most intelligent man I've ever met. Cares about students to a fault. Big reason I decided to pursue Ph.D. - I esteem to be half the professor he is.

JT is one of the most valuable assets at the University. You would be hardpressed to find a more engaging, eloquent, and interesting instructor anywhere.  If you want to see a professor at the top of his game, look no further.
Everyone should take a class with Treadway before they graduate--he actually makes history interesting! He's the best!

John Treadway is an unbelievable professor. His credentials withstanding, his knowledge about Balkan affairs and the Holocaust is unmatched. As an alum, I want to encourage every history major to take as many courses with him!
Treadway is the best teacher I've ever had, and he made me want to get my masters in history.  Very smart and fun to be around.
Who knew history could be such an enjoyable experience?
Take a class with this man....he's awesome.  One of the most intelligent men I've ever met.

Treadway is a great prof.... fun and entertaining, I always feel like i've learned something and had a good time while at it.  Can be kind of hard on grading, but is always looking to help students out.
